scope: Native visibility/font/route evidence only, not a new independent linguistic review.
method: Viewed original font-panel-1/2/3 PNGs directly at full tool resolution. Then viewed all five labelled 1350x2060 contact sheets, with each representative resized from 900x2000 to 450x1000. Representatives were selected by exact SHA-256 deduplication: all 45 original PNGs are covered by 25 distinct groups. This is not a claim that every original was viewed separately at original resolution.
observations: All 29 scoped Han are legible in the three original Compose panels across Gothic, Mincho, Textbook and Brush. No blank/replacement box observed. The two-stroke 冫 and three-stroke 氵 remain distinct; 冶/治/台/始 are distinguishable. Bundled cmap absence for 冫/氵 does not identify the actual fallback face.

N1 selection shows 113 cards. Meaning question and feedback show 冶 with the intended gloss and three wrong choices. Curated on question selects ヤ; feedback identifies on'yomi and the Done screen reports one of one correct. The feedback's full lookup reading list also shows いる; it is not an offered kun question.

The 冶 article's facts, meaning, labelled mnemonic, full on/kun rows, source-only qualification, useful compounds, look-alikes and dictionary/source passages are visible across scroll states. Horizontal table scrolling is required and advertised. The labels and explanation are collectively visible; no single screenshot shows every table column simultaneously.

冶金 meaning, both Japanese examples and translations, composition, distinctions and source line are readable across article scroll states. Exact added 冶金 bullet in 金 is visible. Four directed reciprocal transitions and return positions are corroborated by the terminal native case and screenshots.

Drawing shows seven reference strokes, injected trace feedback and give-up recall feedback. Offline screenshot explicitly says handwriting model unavailable and grading by stroke shapes only. This does not demonstrate handwriting recognition, human recall or a physical phone.
independentVisualConfirmation: pending two serial original-family reviewers; none launched in execution551
limits: Coordinator contact-sheet inspection is not independent two-family visual acceptance. Actual source/review/read-depth/process/permission/OOM/viewport/MLKit limitations retained. Emulator API35/fontScale1 only; no physical-phone, human memory, handwriting-recognition, general-release, whole-set or publication acceptance. 116 individual and four whole-word Paint assertions/raster hashes are not 120 separate PNG reads or fallback-face proof.
